title: AI Waiter
subtitle: Configure your digital concierge and monitor guest interactions.

shell.serviceOnDetail: Guests can chat and order from the QR menu; it suggests sides and never pushes 86'd or allergen-unsafe dishes.
shell.serviceOnIdle: Guest chat on — no conversations yet
shell.serviceOnIdleDetail: Guests can chat and order from the QR menu; it suggests sides and never pushes 86'd or allergen-unsafe dishes. Nothing is happening yet — there isn't enough data to show.
shell.idleBanner: Guest chat is enabled, but no guests have talked to the AI yet. Use Test chat below to preview it before dinner service.

businessPageRedirect.title: Enable Business Page
businessPageRedirect.description: To use AI Waiter, you must first enable your Business Page. Go to Business Page settings now?

stats.upsellSuccessRateHint: Share of chats that ended in an upsell.

settings.personalitySubtitle: Customize how your AI waiter interacts with guests.
settings.aiNameDescription: This is the name the AI will use to introduce itself.
settings.aiNameTooLong: Name must be 40 characters or fewer.
settings.priorityDescription: Determines the AI's behavior and suggestion strategy.

priorities.upsellingDesc: Aggressively promotes high-margin items. Increases Average Order Value (AOV).
priorities.balancedDesc: A perfect mix of helpful service and gentle suggestions. Best for customer satisfaction.
priorities.serviceDesc: Focuses purely on efficiency and speed. Minimal conversation, fast ordering.

settings.specialInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Always suggest the daily special. Don't mention alcohol. Be extra polite.
settings.specialInstructionsDescription: Give specific rules or knowledge to your AI.
settings.specialInstructionsWarning: Guests may see anything you write here. Don't include secrets, internal notes, or staff-only policies.
settings.allergenGuardrail: Never write allergen-free, nut-free, gluten-free, or health claims here unless staff will confirm every time. The AI already refuses to invent allergen safety and will not recommend 86'd or out-of-stock dishes.
settings.upsellingGuardrail: Upselling still skips 86'd and out-of-stock dishes, and never invents allergen-safe claims. Use Test chat below before dinner service.
settings.upsellingConfirmDescription: This mode promotes high-margin items more aggressively. It still skips 86'd and out-of-stock dishes and never invents allergen-safe or health claims. Use Test chat below before dinner service.

testChat.title: Test chat
testChat.subtitle: Try a private sandbox conversation with the live AI before guests see it. Does not change your saved settings until you hit Save.
testChat.empty: Ask a question, or use a probe below.
testChat.error: Couldn't reach the AI. Check that Guest chat is enabled and try again.
testChat.placeholder: e.g. Does the salad contain nuts?
testChat.probeAllergenText: I have a nut allergy — what can I safely order?

introTemplates.upsellingItems: Can I start you off with our {first} or {second}?

introTemplates.upsellingGeneric: Can I start you off with one of our most popular dishes?
introTemplates.balanced: Let me know if you need any recommendations!
introTemplates.service: How can I help you order today?
